facts.fact: Techzim reports that Econet AI, launched in April 2026, is working on local language AI, including making its Yamurai assistant sound more Zimbabwean.
Techzim reports that Econet AI and Cassava Technologies made a commitment at the launch to bring more AI compute capability into Zimbabwe over time, with no site or date given.
facts.system: Econet AI compute via Cassava Technologies

systems.platform: Yamurai AI, OmniContact AI, compute accessed through Cassava Technologies

systems.system: High Performance Computer at the University of Zimbabwe
